```{r}
# List all CSV files in the directory
csv_files <- list.files(path = "/Users/mattparker/Dropbox/Workspace/moops/manuscript1/data/experiment_all/sample_taxon_reports", pattern = ".*.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
seq_metrics = read.csv("/Users/mattparker/Dropbox/Workspace/moops/manuscript1/data/sequencing_summary_metrics_all.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Process all CSV files and combine them
all_data <- bind_rows(lapply(csv_files, process_csv_file))

# Create a metadata dataframe to merge with taxon data
sample_metadata = seq_metrics %>% 
  select(sample_name, water_control, infection_class) %>% 
  mutate(
  # Library prep: MSSPE if ends with "_M"
  library_prep = if_else(str_ends(sample_name, "_M"), "MSSPE", "NGS"),

  # Remove the _M suffix to get the core sample identifier
  core = str_remove(sample_name, "_M$"),
  # Detect experiment 3 first (Cxxx_LPx)
  is_exp3 = str_detect(core, "C\\d+.*LP\\d+"),

  # Base: first sample ID (e.g. S10, PC1)
  base = str_extract(core, "^[A-Za-z]+\\d+"),

  # Append -2 or -3 only if not exp3
  suffix = case_when(
    !is_exp3 & str_detect(core, "_2$") ~ "-2",
    !is_exp3 & str_detect(core, "_3$") ~ "-3",
    TRUE ~ ""
  ),

  base_sample = tolower(paste0(base, suffix)),

  experiment = case_when(
    is_exp3 ~ 3,
    str_detect(core, "_3$") ~ 2,
    TRUE ~ 1
  )
) %>%
select(sample_name, base_sample, library_prep, experiment, water_control, infection_class)

# Merge the taxonomy data with metadata
merged_data <- all_data %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata, by = "sample_name")

# get hpv data from experiment 1 & 2
hpv_data = merged_data %>% 
  filter(str_detect(name, regex("Alphapapillomavirus", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>% 
  filter(experiment == 1 | experiment == 2)

# remove MSSPE libraries that are also experiment 1 (after we have already pulled the hpv rows)
#merged_data = merged_data %>% filter(!(experiment == 1 & library_prep == "MSSPE"))

# Filter to include only species level (tax_level == 1) to avoid duplication
all_data_species <- merged_data %>%
  filter(tax_level == 1) %>% 
  filter(experiment == 2 | experiment == 3) %>%  # filter in specific experiments
  filter(water_control == "No") %>%   # filter out Negative Controls
  filter(!base_sample %in% c("pc1","pc3")) # filter out zymo fecal controls

# add hpv data to the rest of the data
all_data_species = all_data_species %>% 
  add_row(hpv_data)
```


```{r}
# targets to filter to the genus level
genus_targets = c(
  "Bocaparvovirus",
  "Sapelovirus",
  "Circovirus",
  "Enterovirus",
  "Teschovirus",
  "Alphapapillomavirus",
  "Sapovirus",
  "Mamastrovirus",
  "Kobuvirus",
  "Asfivirus",
  "Pestivirus",
  "Aphthovirus",
  "Betaarterivirus",
  "Alphainfluenzavirus",
  "Henipavirus")

# assign these to group species
name_targets = c(
  "PBoV", # porcine bocavirus
  "PCV", # porcine circovirus
  "PKV", # porcine kobuvirus / aichivirus C
  "EV-G", # porcine enterovirus G
  "PTV", # porcine teschovirus 
  "PAstV", # porcine astrovirus
  "PSaV", # porcine sapovirus
  "PSV", # porcine sapelovirus
  "HPV18" # humanpapillomavirus 7/18
)

# specific names that should group together
ent_v = "Enterovirus"
circo_v = "Circovirus"
sapo_v = paste(c("Sapovirus","Sapporo"), collapse = "|")
tes_v = "Teschovirus"
aich_v = "Aichivirus"
astr_v = paste(c("Porcine astrovirus","Mamastrovirus 3"), collapse = "|")
hpv18 = "Alphapapillomavirus"
sapel_v = "Sapelovirus"
boc_v = paste(c("Porcine bocavirus","Bocaparvovirus"), collapse = "|")


all_viruses <- all_data_species %>%
  filter(category == "viruses") %>% 
  filter(is_phage == "false")  # filter out phages

# add name group column
all_viruses = all_viruses %>% 
  mutate(name_group = case_when(
    str_detect(name, regex(hpv18, ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "HPV18",
    str_detect(name, regex(aich_v, ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "PKV",
    str_detect(name, regex(tes_v, ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "PTV",
    str_detect(name, regex(circo_v, ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "PCV",
    str_detect(name, regex(sapo_v, ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "PSaV",
    str_detect(name, regex(sapel_v, ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "PSV",
    str_detect(name, regex(ent_v, ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "EV-G",
    str_detect(name, regex(boc_v, ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "PBoV", 
    str_detect(name, regex(astr_v, ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "PAstV", 
    TRUE ~ name  # Keep original name if no pattern matches
  ))

# Add genus columns to the dataframe
#genus_data <- get_genus_info_batch(all_viruses$tax_id, batch_size = 100)

# Combine with original dataframe
#all_viruses <- cbind(all_viruses, genus_data)

# for 0 rpm values
eps <- 0.1

# filter to only the target viral species or genus
only_viral_targets = all_viruses %>% 
  #filter(!genus_name %in% c("Asfivirus","Pestivirus","Alphapapillomavirus")) %>% # filtering out these genus for now
  group_by(base_sample, library_prep, name_group) %>% 
  filter(str_detect(name_group, regex(paste0("\\b(", paste(name_targets, collapse="|"), ")\\b"), ignore_case = TRUE))) %>% # filter to targeted viruses
  summarize(rpm_mean = mean(nt_rpm, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = library_prep,
    values_from = rpm_mean
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_rpm_enrichment = (`MSSPE` + eps)/(`NGS` + eps),
    log2FC = log2(mean_rpm_enrichment)
  )

# calculate mean so we can add to the boxplot
mean_df <- only_viral_targets %>%
  group_by(name_group) %>%
  summarise(mean_value = mean(mean_rpm_enrichment, na.rm = TRUE))

# plot fold change across all samples
alltarget_boxplot = ggplot(only_viral_targets, aes(x = name_group, y = mean_rpm_enrichment, fill = name_group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_text(data = mean_df,
            aes(x = name_group, y = mean_value, label = paste0("μ: ", round(mean_value, 1))),
            vjust = -1, color = "black", size = 3.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Viral Enrichment - All Samples",
    x = "Virus",
    y = "Mean rPM Fold Change (Enrichment)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

alltarget_boxplot
```

```{r}
# final table for each viral target
viral_target_enrichment_summary = only_viral_targets %>% 
  group_by(name_group) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_rpm_ngs = mean(NGS, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rpm_msspe = mean(MSSPE, na.rm = TRUE),
    fold_enrichment = mean(mean_rpm_enrichment, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr = paste0(
      round(quantile(mean_rpm_enrichment, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      "–",
      round(quantile(mean_rpm_enrichment, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
    ),
    p_value = {
      # ensure both vectors are aligned and remove any NA pairs
      paired_data <- na.omit(data.frame(ngs = NGS, msspe = MSSPE))
      
      if(nrow(paired_data) > 1) {
        wilcox.test(paired_data$ngs,
                    paired_data$msspe,
                    alternative = "two.sided",
                    paired = TRUE)$p.value
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    }
  )

print(viral_target_enrichment_summary)
```

```{r}
# Overall Enrichment

# All viruses & enrichment 
overall_tbl = all_viruses %>% 
  filter(str_detect(name_group, regex(paste0("\\b(", paste(name_targets, collapse="|"), ")\\b"), ignore_case = TRUE))) %>% # filter to targeted viruses
  group_by(name_group, library_prep) %>% 
  summarize(mean_nt_rpm = mean(nt_rpm, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_reads = mean(nt_count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(name_group))

# Calculate fold change for each virus
fold_changes <- overall_tbl %>%
  select(name_group, library_prep, mean_nt_rpm) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = library_prep, values_from = mean_nt_rpm) %>%
  mutate(fold_change = (`MSSPE` + 0.1)/(`NGS` + 0.1), log2FC = log2(fold_change)) %>% 
  select(name_group, fold_change)


# Add fold change back to original data
overall_tbl <- overall_tbl %>%
  left_join(fold_changes, by = "name_group")

# overall mean and median fold change for All Targets
geo_mean_FC <- 2^mean(only_viral_targets$log2FC, na.rm = TRUE); geo_mean_FC
median_FC <- median(only_viral_targets$mean_rpm_enrichment, na.rm = TRUE); median_FC
mean_FC = mean(only_viral_targets$mean_rpm_enrichment, na.rm = TRUE); mean_FC

# Does MSSPE significantly enrich overall all targeted taxa and samples?
wilcox.test(
  only_viral_targets$NGS,
  only_viral_targets$MSSPE,
  paired = TRUE,
  alternative = "two.sided" 
)


# Boxplot of mean_nt_rpm by library_prep
ggplot(overall_tbl, aes(x = library_prep, y = mean_nt_rpm, fill = library_prep)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 21, outlier.fill = "white", width = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6, color = "black", size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10") +  # log scale if nt_rpm varies widely
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Mean rPM",
    title = "Mean rPM Across All Targeted Viruses"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
# Folder containing coverage CSVs
cov_dir <- "/Users/mattparker/Dropbox/Workspace/moops/manuscript1/data/experiment_3/coverage_tables"

# Read all CSV files
cov_files <- list.files(cov_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Function to compute breadth and mean depth from one coverage file
calc_cov_stats <- function(file) {
  df <- read.csv(file)
  tibble(
    file = basename(file),
    virus = str_replace(file, "_s.*|_pc.*", ""),
    base_sample = str_remove(str_extract(basename(file), "(?<=_)(s\\d+|pc\\d+)"), "_"),
    prep = ifelse(str_detect(file, "_m"), "MSSPE", "NGS"),
    ref_length = nrow(df),
    breadth_1x = mean(df$Coverage > 0) * 100,
    mean_depth = mean(df$Coverage)
  )
}

# Calculate coverage for all files
cov_summary <- map_dfr(cov_files, calc_cov_stats)

# 3️⃣ Pivot wider for paired comparison
paired_tbl <- cov_summary %>%
  select(virus, base_sample, prep, breadth_1x, mean_depth) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = prep,
    values_from = c(breadth_1x, mean_depth),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{prep}"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    enrichment_breadth = breadth_1x_MSSPE - breadth_1x_NGS,
    enrichment_depth   = mean_depth_MSSPE - mean_depth_NGS
  )

# 5️⃣ Summary table (1 row per metric)
wilcox_summary = paired_tbl %>% 
  group_by(virus) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_ngs = mean(breadth_1x_NGS),
    mean_msspe = mean(breadth_1x_MSSPE),
    mean_enrichment = mean(enrichment_breadth),
    iqr = paste0(
      round(quantile(enrichment_breadth, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      "–",
      round(quantile(enrichment_breadth, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
    ),
    p_value = {
      # keep only rows where both paired values exist
      df <- na.omit(data.frame(
        ngs = breadth_1x_NGS,
        msspe = breadth_1x_MSSPE
      ))

      if (nrow(df) > 1) {
        wilcox.test(df$ngs, df$msspe,
                    paired = TRUE,
                    alternative = "two.sided")$p.value
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    }
)

print(wilcox_summary)
```

```{r}
# Overall mean genome coverage by library prep
# Prepare long-format data for plotting
coverage_long <- paired_tbl %>%
  select(virus, base_sample, breadth_1x_NGS, breadth_1x_MSSPE) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(breadth_1x_NGS, breadth_1x_MSSPE),
    names_to = "library_prep",
    values_to = "mean_coverage"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    library_prep = recode(library_prep,
                          "breadth_1x_NGS" = "NGS",
                          "breadth_1x_MSSPE" = "MSSPE")
  )

# Boxplot
ggplot(coverage_long, aes(x = virus, y = mean_coverage, fill = library_prep)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = 21, outlier.fill = "white") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5, color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Mean Genome Coverage",
    title = "Genome Coverage by Library Prep",
    fill = "Library Prep"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
